project.name: turbo
project.description: Scalable Python wrapper around the Turbospectrum Fortran radiative-transfer code for generating large synthetic stellar spectral grids (LTE + NLTE) targeted at ML emulator training. Active development focuses on config-driven pipeline scripts (scripts/, configs/) wrapping the legacy Fortran science code in source/, exec-*/, interpolator/, and Utilities/. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.languageNotes: Uses sys.path.insert to dynamically import sibling grid-generation modules; subprocess.run drives synthesis as a child process with worker back-off on OOM SIGKILL.

nodes.name: _abs_output_from
nodes.summary: Resolves a possibly-relative output path against the run root or config directory, returning an absolute path while honoring run-root-relative conventions.

nodes.name: _deep_merge
nodes.summary: Recursively merges an override dict into a base dict, deep-copying values so nested config overrides do not mutate the source structures.

nodes.name: _normalize_synthesis_overrides
nodes.summary: Normalizes synthesis override paths (project root, linelist/NLTE paths, info files) to absolute form relative to the config directory before they are merged into the Turbospectrum config.

nodes.name: _generate_grid
nodes.summary: Builds the parameter grid from config by dynamically importing the grid-generation module, resolving columns and IO, and writing CSV, parameter_grid.zarr, and index.parquet outputs.

nodes.name: _write_temp_turbospectrum_config
nodes.summary: Materializes an effective Turbospectrum synthesis config by merging the base config with normalized overrides, applying NLTE switches and grid-derived output mode, then writing it to a unique temp JSON file.

nodes.name: _nlte_preflight_or_exit
nodes.summary: Runs the NLTE preflight check against the config and exits the process with an error message if required NLTE atom/departure data is missing.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Runs a synthesis subprocess command, and on a SIGKILL return code (likely OOM) retries once with the worker count halved by rewriting the --workers flag.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that parses arguments, loads the pipeline config, optionally generates the grid, then orchestrates either sharded or single-pass Turbospectrum synthesis via subprocess invocations.

nodes.name: test_pipeline_from_config.py
nodes.summary: Unit test that verifies the OOM-recovery behavior in `pipeline_from_config._run`: when a mocked subprocess raises a SIGKILL-style CalledProcessError, the runner must retry once with `--workers` halved.

nodes.name: PipelineFromConfigRunTests
nodes.summary: TestCase that mocks `subprocess.run` to assert `_run` retries with halved `--workers` after a SIGKILL return code, confirming the documented OOM-recovery contract.

nodes.name: test_regular_grid_validation.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit-test suite covering the regular-grid synthesizer's validation helpers (success/failure detection, continuum-save verification, NaN flux rejection), config materialization (linelist/NLTE/mu-range overrides), regular-column expansion, turbvel snapping, and the pipeline's temp Turbospectrum config writer.

nodes.name: RegularGridValidationTests
nodes.summary: TestCase aggregating 13 tests that exercise synthesis-result validation, continuum verification, synthesis-config materialization (linelist, NLTE info, mu-range), regular-column construction including mu-axis expansion and turbvel snapping, and the pipeline's temp turbospectrum config writer.

nodes.name: compute_binary_manifest_hash
nodes.summary: Hashes a list of binary file paths plus their content digests to fingerprint the Turbospectrum executables embedded in provenance.

nodes.name: test_synthesis_params_preserve_turbvel_and_t_value
nodes.summary: Asserts that per-row synthesis preserves the turbvel and t_value columns it received from the grid.

nodes.name: test_merged_params_preserve_turbvel_and_t_value
nodes.summary: Asserts that the merged spectra zarr still carries turbvel and t_value columns in the consolidated parameter matrix.

nodes.name: _print_report
nodes.summary: Prints the aggregated CheckResult list with PASS/FAIL/SKIP coloring and returns the overall exit code.

nodes.name: zarr_store
nodes.summary: Returns a zarr store object for the given path under either zarr v2 (DirectoryStore) or v3 (LocalStore) APIs.

nodes.name: PathResolutionTests
nodes.summary: Verifies _resolve_paths discovers grid zarr, shard dir, merged zarr, output dir and atmosphere dir from the configs.

nodes.name: MergedConsistencyTests
nodes.summary: Tests check_merged_consistency for matching shards, undersized merged store, and absent merged zarr.

nodes.name: IntermediateArtifactsTests
nodes.summary: Tests check_intermediate_artifacts skips cleanly when no intermediates remain and flags missing specs when only some rows are materialized.

nodes.name: _regular_grid_row
nodes.summary: Builds a single-row regular grid via _build_regular_columns at the solar-like test point so it can be diffed against the LHS path.

nodes.name: _lhs_grid_row
nodes.summary: Builds a single LHS-sampled row at the same physical point using generate_grid helpers, to mirror the regular-grid fixture for diffing.

nodes.name: DepartureCandidate
nodes.summary: Lightweight record describing one candidate departure file with its parsed abundance, used during nearest-match selection.

nodes.name: _canonical_species_symbol
nodes.summary: Normalizes a user-provided species spec (Z, symbol, or 'Fe I') to a canonical element symbol used to index departure files.

nodes.name: build_nlte_ascii_selector_columns
nodes.summary: Expands a single NlteAsciiSelector into row-aligned NumPy columns so per-row selector metadata can travel through the grid Zarr.

nodes.name: _build_departure_index
nodes.summary: Scans a departure-file directory once and returns a cached list of DepartureCandidate entries keyed by parsed abundance for fast nearest-match lookup.

nodes.name: _stage_departure_file
nodes.summary: Stages a chosen departure file into the per-run output directory via copy or symlink, respecting the prefer_copy preference for HPC scratch.

nodes.name: _validate_mu_angles
nodes.summary: Validates a user-supplied mu-angles sequence (in (0,1] domain, non-empty, sorted) before writing it to disk for Turbospectrum.

nodes.name: _vmicro_to_label
nodes.summary: Converts a microturbulent velocity in km/s to the two-digit MARCS atmosphere label (e.g. 1.0 -> '01') used for model selection.

nodes.name: init_nlte_config.py

nodes.languageNotes: Adds its own directory to sys.path before importing the sibling nlte_config helper module.

nodes.name: _build_config
nodes.summary: Assembles the pipeline config dict from CLI args, choosing binary vs ASCII NLTE workflow and resolving line-list/atmosphere paths.

nodes.name: _patch_species_map

nodes.name: apply_single_nlte_switch
nodes.summary: Mutates a synthesis config in place so that nlte.enabled is driven by the grid's calculation_mode, emitting a warning when the two signals disagree.

nodes.name: preflight_nlte
nodes.summary: Validates an NLTE setup end-to-end: checks the ASCII departures directory, parses the binary info file, verifies every referenced model atom and departure grid exists, and returns a list of human-readable problems.

nodes.name: synthesis_nlte_block

nodes.name: preflight_nlte_from_config
nodes.summary: High-level preflight wrapper that extracts the relevant NLTE settings from a pipeline config and delegates to preflight_nlte with resolved project_root.

nodes.name: nlte_is_enabled
nodes.summary: Returns True if either the grid calculation_mode is NLTE or the synthesis config explicitly enables nlte.

nodes.name: setup_nlte.py

nodes.name: _scan
nodes.summary: Walks the model atoms and departure grid directories and returns dicts mapping each element symbol to its discovered atom and grid filenames.

nodes.name: _pair_grids_with_aux
nodes.summary: Pairs binary departure-grid files with their aux/abund sidecar files by stem matching, returning the paired list and any unpaired stragglers.

nodes.name: _ascii_export
nodes.summary: Drives the optional ASCII export pass, invoking the export_all helper to convert paired binary grids into per-abundance ASCII files under a species-named output directory.

nodes.name: _build_species_map
nodes.summary: Emits the multi-line SPECIES_LTE_NLTE.dat content for every scanned element, flagging NLTE for elements with a matching departure file (and respecting the --nlte allowlist).

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that orchestrates the optional data download, scans inputs, writes the species map (with backup), runs preflight, and optionally performs ASCII export.

nodes.name: validate_nlte_config.py
nodes.summary: Lightweight CLI that loads a pipeline/regular-grid config JSON and runs preflight_nlte_from_config so users catch missing NLTE inputs before launching a long synthesis run; exits 1 on problems.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses the --config arg, loads and strips private keys from the config, then runs the NLTE preflight and prints any problems with download hints.

nodes.name: test_nlte_config.py
nodes.summary: Unittest suite covering the nlte_config helpers and the init_nlte_config / setup_nlte CLIs, exercising single-switch behavior, preflight scenarios (ASCII and binary workflows), species-map generation, and an end-to-end ASCII export round-trip.

nodes.name: SingleSwitchTests

nodes.name: BlockLocationTests
nodes.summary: Asserts synthesis_nlte_block prefers top-level synthesis over grid.synthesis and returns an empty dict when no block exists.

nodes.name: PreflightTests
nodes.summary: Covers preflight_nlte across disabled, ASCII (missing/empty/present), and binary scenarios including missing info files, departure files, and all-LTE entries.

nodes.name: PreflightFromConfigTests
nodes.summary: Validates preflight_nlte_from_config wiring: LTE configs are skipped, the single switch promotes binary workflow inputs, and top-level ASCII blocks override grid blocks.

nodes.name: GeneratorTests
nodes.summary: Tests init_nlte_config's _build_config and _patch_species_map: binary single-switch output, ASCII block insertion, and that the species-map header is repointed with a .bak backup.

nodes.name: SetupNlteTests
nodes.summary: Exercises setup_nlte's filename element parsing, atom/grid scanning (ignoring aux data), species-map flag/format generation, and grid-aux pairing logic.

nodes.name: AsciiExportEndToEndTests
nodes.summary: End-to-end test that fabricates a binary departure grid, runs the ASCII export pipeline, and asserts the resulting ASCII file is well-formed and matchable.

nodes.name: ARCHITECTURE.md

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Onboarding guide for Claude Code agents that lists the required architectural contracts, build/run commands, repository layout, and non-obvious conventions for the Turbospectrum wrapper.

nodes.name: DATA_CONTRACT.md

nodes.name: FAILURE_MODES.md

nodes.summary: Enumerates 15 core system invariants (reproducibility, shard independence, immutability, idempotency, frozen parameter space, config-as-truth, etc.) plus operational invariants that must hold throughout the pipeline.

nodes.name: OPERATIONS.md
nodes.summary: Operator runbook covering preflight checklist, modes of operation (smoke/pilot/production), PBS launch procedure on NCI Gadi, temp/scratch policy, monitoring, failure recovery, and resume flow.

nodes.summary: Project entry-point documentation: setup guide, NLTE quickstart, sampling/synthesis workflows, JAX dataloader usage, sharded-run instructions, testing strategy, and PBS submission examples for Gadi.

nodes.name: REPO_STRUCTURE.md

nodes.summary: Compute spline coefficients (qin, uin) from input grid (xin, yin) for subsequent evaluation by the cubintp family.

nodes.name: cubintp04
nodes.summary: Evaluate the cubic spline at xout points returning yout with 4-byte real I/O.

nodes.name: cubintp08
nodes.summary: Evaluate the cubic spline at xout points returning yout with 8-byte real I/O.

nodes.name: cubintp14
nodes.summary: Cubic spline evaluator variant accepting a 1-byte index array alongside 4-byte real I/O.

nodes.name: cubintp18
nodes.summary: Cubic spline evaluator variant accepting a 1-byte index array alongside 8-byte real I/O.

nodes.name: DEPTH
nodes.summary: Compute partition functions and abundances of element IEL across all atmosphere depth points.

nodes.name: gammln
nodes.summary: Compute the natural log of the gamma function via Lanczos approximation, helper for partition-function sums.

nodes.name: DETABS
nodes.summary: Assemble total continuous absorption and scattering by summing all species-specific opacity contributions at wavelength J for component JP.

nodes.name: DIE_pe
nodes.summary: Solve chemical equilibrium for electron pressure given temperature TEM and species pressures SPE; returns convergence flag, iteration count, and resulting Pe.

nodes.name: eqmol_pe
nodes.summary: Outer driver for molecular equilibrium: iterates with DIE_pe until consistent electron pressure pe and gas pressure pgas are found for temperature tt.

nodes.name: extract_multi
nodes.summary: Standalone program reading a MULTI model file and writing selected fields out for post-processing.

nodes.name: funcv
nodes.summary: Residual vector function for Newton-Raphson iteration of partial-pressure consistency in the molecular equilibrium solver.

nodes.name: GAUSI
nodes.summary: Generate K-point Gauss-Legendre nodes AI and weights XMYI on the interval [A, B].

nodes.name: getinfospecies
nodes.summary: Decode a Turbospectrum species code into element id, atom count, per-atom Z, and isotope identifiers.

nodes.name: getisotopmass
nodes.summary: Return atomic mass in amu for the requested isotope/element using built-in lookup tables.

nodes.name: getlele
nodes.summary: Map element index and ionisation stage to spectroscopic label string (lele) for output formatting.

nodes.name: BPL
nodes.summary: Planck blackbody intensity at temperature T and wavelength X in cgs units.

nodes.name: h2borysowopac.f
nodes.summary: Computes H2 collision-induced absorption opacity contributions from Borysow tables (placeholder/dispatcher wrapping the underlying Borysow opacity data).
nodes.languageNotes: Fixed-form Fortran 77 subroutine receiving (omega,t,propac); interfaces with Borysow CIA tables.

nodes.name: h2opac.f
nodes.summary: Provides H2O continuous opacity computation as a function of frequency and temperature for cool stellar atmospheres.

nodes.name: h2opartf.f
nodes.summary: Returns the H2O molecular partition function on a tabulated temperature grid; used by molecular equilibrium for cool-star chemistry.

nodes.name: h2opartf2001.f
nodes.summary: Alternative 2001-era H2O partition-function implementation kept as a per-depth (ntau) variant alongside the legacy table-based routine.

nodes.name: hbop.f
nodes.summary: Hydrogen bound-bound and bound-free opacity engine (Barklem/Piskunov 2003) implementing the Daeppen-Anderson-Mihalas occupation-probability formalism with HHL non-LTE extension; bundles HLINOP/HPROFL profile evaluators plus Stark/HFNM/SOFBET/HBF and interpolation helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Large monolithic Fortran 77 file with eleven public REAL/REAL*8 functions and two helper subroutines (LOGINT, POLINT); contains both LTE and NLTE code paths selected by NL>0.

nodes.name: heborysowopac.f
nodes.summary: He collision-induced absorption opacity wrapper around Borysow's tables; companion to h2borysowopac for cool-atmosphere CIA continua.

nodes.name: heopac.f
nodes.summary: Helium continuous opacity computation as a function of frequency and temperature for atmospheric radiative-transfer.

nodes.name: hlinprof.f
nodes.summary: Hydrogen line-profile suite by Paul Barklem combining Stehle and VCS tabulated Stark profiles with self/HE pressure-broadening, radiative widths, and Ali-Griem analytic formulae for Balmer-series detailed treatment.
nodes.languageNotes: Eight subroutines dispatched through HLINPROF; reads external HFILE tabulations (Stehle, HGRID, VCS) at runtime.

nodes.name: hydropac.f
nodes.summary: Driver routine that calls HBOP/HLINPROF to assemble hydrogen line opacity contributions across the wavelength grid, with NLTE departure-coefficient hand-off and per-layer caching.

nodes.name: inabs.f
nodes.summary: INABS reads and configures continuum absorber data (H-, H, He, metals, molecules, scattering) used by the MARCS/Turbospectrum absorption coefficient module; populates the COMMON blocks consumed by JON/ABSKO.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure setup routine — single SUBROUTINE INABS(IOUTS) that fills shared COMMON blocks; no internal sub-routines.

nodes.name: injon.f
nodes.summary: INJON reads atomic-physics input (ionisation potentials, partition functions, element abundances) and prepares the data structures consumed by JON for chemical equilibrium and electron-pressure solution.

nodes.name: inp3.f
nodes.summary: Tiny three-point parabolic interpolation helper used by various Turbospectrum tabulators (INP3(X,Y,XINT,YINT)).

nodes.name: input.f
nodes.summary: Top-level INPUT subroutine that orchestrates reading of the user namelist/control file for a synthesis run, dispatching to specialized readers (INABS, INJON, abundance, linelist) and populating run-wide COMMON state.

nodes.name: Iplus_calc.f
nodes.summary: Computes the outgoing specific intensity I+ at the top of the atmosphere by formal integration of a source function over optical depth, with an optically-thin branch for weak lines.

nodes.name: jon.f
nodes.summary: JON solves the chemical-equilibrium / electron-pressure problem for one atmospheric layer given T and Pe, returning gas pressure, density, internal energy and partial pressures used by absorption-coefficient routines.
nodes.languageNotes: Classic MARCS/Turbospectrum equation-of-state kernel; called per depth point during atmosphere interpolation and synthesis.

nodes.name: lenstr.f
nodes.summary: String-length utility that returns the position of the last non-blank character in a CHARACTER buffer (LENSTR).

nodes.name: lint.f
nodes.summary: Linear interpolation helper LINT(N,X,YY,XINT,YYINT) for 1-D tabulated data.

nodes.name: lowercase_conversion.f90
nodes.summary: Free-form Fortran 90 utility that converts an input string to lowercase by ASCII offset for case-insensitive keyword matching.
nodes.languageNotes: One of the very few free-form .f90 files in the source tree; the rest of the kernel is fixed-form F77.

nodes.name: lubksb.f
nodes.summary: Numerical Recipes LU back-substitution routine that solves A.x=b given the LU factorisation produced by LUDCMP.

nodes.name: ludcmp.f
nodes.summary: Numerical Recipes LU decomposition routine (with partial pivoting and singular-matrix detection); paired with LUBKSB to solve linear systems used in equilibrium and matrix-inversion contexts.

nodes.name: makeabund.f
nodes.summary: Builds the per-element abundance vector by combining a baseline solar pattern (Grevesse/Asplund/etc.) with overall metallicity, alpha enhancement, helium and explicit fixabund overrides, and writes the formatted abundance file plus isotopic fractions consumed by INJON.
nodes.languageNotes: Operates on natom=92 elements with isotope sub-table (0:250); selectable solar reference via abund_source argument.

nodes.name: molecpartf.f
nodes.summary: Molecular partition-function lookup that returns partition values for a requested species at the given temperature, signalling whether the species was found.

nodes.name: moleq.f
nodes.summary: Solves molecular equilibrium for the principal H/C/N/O bearing species at a layer, returning H-, H2, H2+ partial-pressure fractions used by JON during EOS evaluation.

nodes.name: molfys.f
nodes.summary: Computes the H2 and H2+ dissociation/equilibrium constants (XKH2, XKH2P) and dissociation energies needed by MOLEQ for hydrogen chemistry at temperature T.

nodes.name: molmat.f
nodes.summary: Builds the molecular-equilibrium coefficient matrix combining elemental abundances with molecular dissociation constants for the H/C/N/O/S/K subsystem used by JON's chemistry solver.

nodes.name: HBOP
nodes.summary: Returns total hydrogen bound absorption (line + bound-free) at wavelength WAVE for a supplied line list, supporting both LTE (NL=0) and NLTE (population array NPOP, departure coefficients) modes via the occupation-probability formalism.

nodes.name: HLINOP
nodes.summary: Normalised hydrogen line profile evaluator selecting the appropriate Stark + self-broadening treatment for a Balmer/Lyman/Paschen transition; usable standalone outside HBOP.

nodes.name: HPROFL
nodes.summary: Detailed hydrogen Stark profile function combining quasistatic ion broadening with electron impact wings; honours the RAYLCUT cutoff parameter.

nodes.name: STARK1
nodes.summary: Single-line Stark broadening calculator for transition (N,M) at wavelength WAVE given temperature and electron density.

nodes.name: HFNM
nodes.summary: Returns the hydrogen oscillator strength f_nm for transition (N,M) using Menzel-Pekeris formulae.

nodes.name: VCSE1F
nodes.summary: Rational approximation of the exponential integral E1(x) used by VCS Stark profile tables.

nodes.name: SOFBET
nodes.summary: Evaluates the Schoening/Butler/Vidal-Cooper-Smith S(beta) Stark profile function for hydrogen lines as a function of reduced field strength beta and Doppler parameter P.

nodes.name: AIRVAC
nodes.summary: Converts an air wavelength to vacuum wavelength using the standard refractive-index formula (double precision).

nodes.name: VACAIR
nodes.summary: Inverse of AIRVAC: converts a vacuum wavelength to air wavelength (double precision).

nodes.name: WCALC
nodes.summary: Computes the occupation probability w_n for a given hydrogen level following Hummer & Mihalas / DAM formalism, accounting for neutral and charged perturbers.

nodes.name: HBF
nodes.summary: Hydrogen bound-free absorption cross section at wavelength WAVE from level NLO using Gaunt-factor tabulation.

nodes.name: LOGINT
nodes.summary: Log-log linear interpolation helper for opacity tables.

nodes.name: POLINT
nodes.summary: Numerical Recipes polynomial interpolation with error estimate, used by tabulated profile look-ups.

nodes.name: HLINPROF
nodes.summary: Top-level dispatcher returning a hydrogen line profile at WAVE for transition (NLOW,NUP); chooses between Stehle tables, VCS grid, Ali-Griem and analytic widths according to species/regime.

nodes.name: STEHLE
nodes.summary: Loads and interpolates Stehle/Hutcheon hydrogen Stark line-profile tables for a given (NLOW,NUP) transition at T and Ne.

nodes.name: HGRID
nodes.summary: Reads and interpolates a precomputed hydrogen-line profile grid (HFILE) over delta-lambda, temperature and NH density for an arbitrary upper/lower-level pair.

nodes.name: HSELF_PDWIDTH
nodes.summary: Computes pressure-damping width contribution from H-H self-broadening for a specified Balmer line at temperature T and H1 number density.

nodes.name: HE_PDWIDTH
nodes.summary: Computes pressure-damping width contribution from neutral helium broadening for a hydrogen line.

nodes.name: RAD_WIDTH
nodes.summary: Returns the radiative (natural) line width for a hydrogen transition by summing upper-state Einstein A coefficients.

nodes.name: ALI_GRIEM
nodes.summary: Implements the Ali-Griem analytic Stark-broadening width formula for hydrogen lines as a function of H1 fraction.

nodes.name: VCS
nodes.summary: Vidal-Cooper-Smith Stark-profile interpolation over a precomputed HVCSFILE grid; provides the wing/asymptotic Stark profile for hydrogen lines.

nodes.name: INABS
nodes.summary: Reads continuum-absorber control input and populates the COMMON-block parameter tables (H-, scattering, metal photoionisation cross-sections, molecular continua) used by ABSKO/JON at synthesis time.

nodes.name: INJON
nodes.summary: Reads atomic input (abundances, ionisation potentials, partition functions) and prepares COMMON-block tables consumed by JON for the equation of state and ionisation/molecular equilibrium.

nodes.name: input
nodes.summary: Top-level INPUT orchestrator reading the synthesis namelist/control input and delegating to specialised readers for absorbers, atomic data, abundances and linelists; main driver of run setup.

nodes.name: JON
nodes.summary: Solves chemical equilibrium for a single atmospheric layer at (T,Pe), returning total gas pressure, density, internal energy and ion/molecule partial pressures consumed by absorption-coefficient routines.

nodes.name: makeabund
nodes.summary: Scales an internal solar abundance table by overall metallicity, alpha, helium and r/s contributions, applies fixabund overrides, and writes the resulting per-element abundance plus mass and isotopic-fraction arrays used downstream.

nodes.name: MOLMAT
nodes.summary: Builds the molecular-equilibrium coefficient matrix and right-hand side for the H/C/N/O/S/K subsystem from elemental abundances and dissociation constants for solution inside the EOS chain.

nodes.name: molecpartf
nodes.summary: Looks up molecular partition-function values at temperature T for the requested species; sets a found flag to signal availability so callers can fall back on alternative data.

nodes.name: newvoigt.f
nodes.summary: Provides the high-speed Voigt function implementation (Humlicek approximation) used throughout Turbospectrum for line opacity profile calculations.
nodes.languageNotes: Fixed-form Fortran 77 with a single REAL FUNCTION using double complex arithmetic for Humlicek's W4 approximation.

nodes.name: newVOIGT
nodes.summary: Computes the Voigt function H(a,v) via Humlicek's approximation, normalized to area 1/sqrt(pi); fastest accurate routine per BE+NP 1997 benchmark.

nodes.name: nhop.f
nodes.summary: Provides NH photoionization LTE cross-sections via lookup table interpolation, based on data from Phillip Stancil (2019).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SAVE/DATA first-call pattern to load the tabulated cross-section file once and reuse across calls.

nodes.name: NHOP
nodes.summary: Returns NH molecular photoionization cross-section in A^2 by bilinearly interpolating a wavelength-temperature lookup table loaded on first call.

nodes.name: eqwidt.f
nodes.summary: Obsolete main program (forked from bsyn ~2000) for computing LTE equivalent widths from a line list, iterating on abundance or producing curves of growth.
nodes.languageNotes: Large legacy main program (1356 lines) using extensive COMMON blocks; superseded by current bsyn-based workflow but kept for reference.

nodes.name: eqwidt
nodes.summary: Main driver that reads model atmosphere, line list, and abundances, then iterates per-line abundance fits to match observed equivalent widths.

nodes.name: eqwidtb.f
nodes.summary: Obsolete spherical-geometry equivalent width integrator called from eqwidt; integrates the synthesized line profile to a single EW value.

nodes.name: eqwidtb
nodes.summary: Computes equivalent width for a single line in spherical geometry by sweeping a wavelength grid and calling traneq for radiative transfer at each point.

nodes.name: eqwidtbplatt.f
nodes.summary: Obsolete plane-parallel equivalent width integrator (Plez/Platt variant) called from eqwidt; the plane-parallel counterpart to eqwidtb.

nodes.name: eqwidtbplatt
nodes.summary: Computes equivalent width in plane-parallel geometry using Gauss-mu quadrature; calls traneqplatt and tranw to solve transfer at each wavelength.

nodes.name: partf.f
nodes.summary: Provides atomic partition functions for ionization stages I-III across the periodic table, plus specialised routines for U II/III and Th II/III.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes a long parameterised polynomial table (the partf subroutine) with smaller per-element specialty functions loaded from disk via DATA/tableU*.dat.

nodes.name: partf
nodes.summary: Returns the partition function U and ionization potential of a given atom and ionization stage at temperature T using hard-coded polynomial coefficients.

nodes.name: PARTITU2
nodes.summary: Computes UII partition function from energy/g-weight levels loaded once from DATA/tableU2.dat on first call.

nodes.name: PARTITU3
nodes.summary: Computes UIII partition function from energy/g-weight levels loaded once from DATA/tableU3.dat on first call.

nodes.name: partitth2
nodes.summary: Returns ThII partition function as a hard-coded sum-of-exponentials expression (Zalubas/Corliss/Klinkenberg level data via Holweger).

nodes.name: partitth3
nodes.summary: Returns ThIII partition function as a hard-coded sum-of-exponentials expression (Zalubas/Corliss/Klinkenberg level data via Holweger).

nodes.name: partfamesh2o.f
nodes.summary: Computes the H2O partition function using ro-vibrational level data from the NASA Ames water linelist.

nodes.name: partfAmesH2O
nodes.summary: Reads Ames H2O ro-vibrational levels (up to 180000) and computes the temperature-dependent partition function via Boltzmann summation.

nodes.name: partfBarberH2O.f
nodes.summary: Computes the H2O partition function using ro-vibrational levels from the Barber et al. (2006) H2O linelist (BT2).

nodes.name: partfBarberH2O
nodes.summary: Reads Barber H2O energy levels once and computes Q(T) with even/odd nuclear spin statistical weights.

nodes.name: partffordepth.f
nodes.summary: Dispatcher that computes molecular partition functions at each atmospheric depth point, routing H2O to one of four backends (Ames/SCAN2001/oldscan/Barber).

nodes.name: partffordepth
nodes.summary: For each of ntau atmospheric depths, looks up or computes the partition function for the given molecule by dispatching to the appropriate H2O backend or molecpartf.

nodes.name: pemake.f
nodes.summary: Iteratively solves for the electron pressure Pe given temperature and gas pressure Pg via modified regula-falsi on the log-log Pg-Pe relation.

nodes.name: PEMAKE
nodes.summary: Improved regula-falsi iteration that calls JON repeatedly to converge electron pressure from an initial guess; widens search range if JON fails.

nodes.name: pemakero.f
nodes.summary: Variant of pemake that solves for electron pressure given temperature and density (rho) instead of gas pressure, used when ro is the imposed quantity.

nodes.name: PEMAKEro
nodes.summary: Regula-falsi iteration on JON to converge electron pressure from a guess when rho (density) is the constraint rather than Pg.

nodes.name: plot2xy.f
nodes.summary: Standalone utility program that converts a binary spectrum plot file (syntspec/synoutf) to a two-column ASCII (wavelength, flux) format.

nodes.name: qas.f
nodes.summary: Computes the asymptotic part of atomic partition functions following Baschek et al. (1966) or Fischel & Sparks (1971), called from qtrav.

nodes.name: QAS
nodes.summary: Returns the asymptotic partition-function contribution using either Baschek's closed form or Fischel-Sparks integral approximation depending on IFISH flag.

nodes.name: qtrav.f
nodes.summary: Computes atomic partition functions per Traving et al. (1966) by summing over electron configurations; consumes shared CI3/CI7 atomic level data.

nodes.name: QTRAV
nodes.summary: Sums Q' contributions over electron configurations and adds the asymptotic QAS term to produce the Traving partition function for one species.

nodes.name: read_departure_csv.f
nodes.summary: Alternate ASCII/CSV reader for NLTE departure coefficients (one model atom + one atmosphere); the simpler counterpart to read_departure.f.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines the same subroutine name `read_departure` as read_departure.f; only one of the two is linked into a given build.

nodes.name: read_departure
nodes.summary: Reads a plain-text NLTE departure-coefficient file (tau + b_i per level) for a single species, skipping `!` comment header lines.

nodes.name: read_departure.f
nodes.summary: Reads NLTE departure coefficients (binary or text) for one model atom plus one atmosphere model, the primary loader used by the NLTE-enabled build.

nodes.name: read_departure
nodes.summary: Reads NLTE departure coefficients in either unformatted-binary or text format; falls back to b=1.0 (LTE) when no file is provided.

nodes.name: read_modelatom.f
nodes.summary: Reads an NLTE model atom file (species, abundance, mass, and per-level energy/g/ion/id) used for departure-coefficient calculations.

nodes.name: read_modelatom
nodes.summary: Parses a NLTE model-atom file with `*`-prefixed comment lines, extracting species id, abundance/mass, and per-level (energy, g, ion-stage, id) entries.

nodes.name: read_nlteinfofile.f
nodes.summary: Reads the per-species NLTE info file specifying for each element whether NLTE is enabled and the paths to its model-atom and departure-coefficient files.

nodes.name: read_nlteinfofile
nodes.summary: Parses the NLTE info file, resolving full paths for the model-atom and departure files of a requested element and reporting whether it should be treated NLTE.

nodes.name: read_segments.f
nodes.summary: Reads a file listing the wavelength segments (lambda_min, lambda_max pairs) over which synthesis should be performed.

nodes.name: read_segments
nodes.summary: Reads (xlsegmin, xlsegmax) wavelength pairs from a segments file, skipping `;`-prefixed comment header lines; aborts if more than nsegmax segments are present.

nodes.name: readfilt.f
nodes.summary: Reads a photometric filter transmission curve (wavelength, transmission) from disk into the /filter/ common block.

nodes.name: readfilt
nodes.summary: Reads a filter transmission curve from the given unit into filtlam/filttrans (up to 1000 points) and stops if dimensions are exceeded.

nodes.name: readmo.f
nodes.summary: Reads model atmosphere data and interpolates absorption and scattering coefficients at the requested wavelength XL for all optical-depth points.

nodes.name: READMO
nodes.summary: For wavelength XL, fills the X (absorption) and S (scattering) coefficient arrays per depth point by linear interpolation in the model-atmosphere's wavelength grid.

nodes.name: rinteg.f
nodes.summary: Generic numerical integration helpers (rinteg and parcoe) originally from ATLAS6 via MOOG, used for cumulative integration of tabulated functions.

nodes.name: rinteg
nodes.summary: Computes the cumulative integral of f(x) over a tabulated grid using quadratic coefficients fitted by parcoe; returns the final value plus per-interval contributions.

nodes.name: parcoe
nodes.summary: Fits quadratic interpolation coefficients (a, b, c) to a tabulated function f(x) for use by rinteg.

nodes.name: rossop.f
nodes.summary: Computes the Rosseland mean opacity at a single depth point by calling JON and ABSKO on the first wavelength scale defined in INITAB.

nodes.name: ROSSOP
nodes.summary: Returns the Rosseland mean opacity at depth k for temperature T and electron pressure PE by combining JON's continuous absorption with ABSKO's line+continuum result.

nodes.name: spectrum.inc
nodes.summary: Central INCLUDE file defining maximum-dimension parameters (NDP, NRAYS, lpoint, mkomp, numbset, ...) for static array sizing across Turbospectrum.
nodes.languageNotes: Project's single source of truth for static array dimensions; reducing these parameters trades memory for the maximum supported spectrum size.

nodes.name: strings_module.f90
nodes.summary: Modern Fortran 90 utility module providing case-conversion helpers (to_upper, to_lower) over CHARACTER strings.
nodes.languageNotes: One of the few F90 module-based files in an otherwise F77 codebase; uses PRIVATE/PUBLIC visibility and RESULT clauses.

nodes.name: strings_module
nodes.summary: F90 module exposing to_upper and to_lower string-case converters built atop private to_upper_ch/to_lower_ch character helpers.

nodes.name: to_upper
nodes.summary: Returns the input string with all ASCII letters mapped to uppercase via the per-character helper to_upper_ch.

nodes.name: to_lower
nodes.summary: Returns the input string with all ASCII letters mapped to lowercase via the per-character helper to_lower_ch.

nodes.name: tabs.f
nodes.summary: Legacy Turbospectrum routine TABS that computes interpolation factors in temperature (or theta) for the ABKOF opacity table initialised by INABS, populating AFAK, NOFAK, and NPLATS for downstream opacity evaluation.
nodes.languageNotes: Fixed-form FORTRAN 77; manipulates COMMON-block arrays /CA1/ shared across the radiative-transfer code.

nodes.name: takemolec.f
nodes.summary: Extracts selected molecular partial pressures from the Tsuji equilibrium output (common block 'fullequilibrium') for use in opacity computation and printing; one of the canonical extension points when adding new molecules.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes 'tsuji.par' for molecule/metal array dimensions; must be called after JON + EQMOL.

nodes.name: test-lint.f
nodes.summary: Stand-alone test driver for the LINT linear-interpolation subroutine: sets up a hard-coded table and prints interpolated values across the range.

nodes.name: test.f
nodes.summary: Interactive test driver for the VOIGT line-profile function: reads damping parameter and Doppler width from stdin, computes the integrated profile, and prints the running sum.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains an embedded VOIGT subroutine implementing the Hui-Armstrong-Wray quick reliable Voigt formula.

nodes.name: test2.f
nodes.summary: Duplicate/variant of test.f providing the same interactive VOIGT-profile integration driver — kept alongside as a legacy alternate copy.

nodes.name: tint.f
nodes.summary: One-dimensional interpolation routine TINT using successive halving and a three-point formula (INP3); willingly extrapolates with a warning. Special Canarias export version.

nodes.name: traneq.f
nodes.summary: Core radiative-transfer solver TRANEQ — solves the transfer equation with continuum scattering using Cannon's angular perturbation technique, Stein's matrix-storage trick, and cubic-spline source-function representation.
nodes.languageNotes: Modernised fixed-form FORTRAN with explicit single/double-precision kinds; central physics routine.

nodes.name: traneqplatt.f
nodes.summary: Plane-parallel ('platt') variant of TRANEQ with optional debug output and Aitken extrapolation for accelerated convergence; called for plane-parallel geometry runs.

nodes.name: tranfr.f
nodes.summary: TRANFR formal solver: integrates the transfer equation along rays for a given source function, returns intensities at tau=0 in /CSURF/; uses cubic-spline correction terms AD/BD and even-function mu quadratures via TRQUA2.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest file in this batch — performs matrix-element setup and back-substitution for the Feautrier-style scheme.

nodes.name: tranfrplatt.f
nodes.summary: Plane-parallel variant of TRANFR: formal solver returning flux and surface intensities for the plane-parallel transfer geometry; companion to traneqplatt.

nodes.name: transc.f
nodes.summary: TRANSC solves the transfer equation including continuum scattering in the Eddington (one-ray) approximation; builds the matrix elements consumed by SCATTR for mean-intensity correction.

nodes.name: transcplatt.f
nodes.summary: Plane-parallel TRANSC variant solving the Eddington-approximation continuum-scattering transfer equation; pairs with tranfrplatt/traneqplatt for plane-parallel geometry runs.

nodes.name: tranw.f
nodes.summary: TRANW computes a weighted transfer integral along a single ray (mu = XMY) using Planck source BPLAN and continuum/line opacities X, XL to evaluate the line depression DELI.

nodes.name: trqua2.f
nodes.summary: Cubic-spline quadrature helper TRQUA2 returning the integral of f(x) using trapezoidal sum plus a 1/12 dx^2 derivative-change correction; used by TRANFR for angular quadrature over even functions of mu.

nodes.name: trrays.f
nodes.summary: TRRAYS sets up the per-depth mu-grid and ray structure (PFEAU geometry) used by the spherical TRANFR/TRANSC solvers, sharing state via /CTRAN/ and /TAUC/ commons.

nodes.name: tryck.f
nodes.summary: Fast pressure-integration routine TRYCK: integrates the hydrostatic d ln P / d ln tau equation iterating directly on electron pressure to minimise ABSKO calls; assumes power-law behaviour for the starting boundary condition.

nodes.name: tsuji.par
nodes.summary: Tiny Fortran include file declaring molecule/metal table dimensions (maxmol=60, maxmet=40) shared by the Tsuji-equilibrium machinery used in sosmarcs and takemolec.
nodes.languageNotes: Fortran PARAMETER include — these maxima are consumed via INCLUDE 'tsuji.par' across the source tree.

nodes.name: weightlimb.f
nodes.summary: Computes limb-darkened, filter-weighted disk-integrated intensity by interpolating surface intensities at fixed mu and combining with a transmission filter loaded from /filter/.

nodes.name: xy2moog.f
nodes.summary: Stand-alone converter program that reads an (x,y) spectrum file and writes it in MOOG-compatible format; interactively prompts for input file, output file, and spectrum title.

nodes.name: zerof.f
nodes.summary: Tiny Newton-step helper ZEROF that returns DX = -F/DFDX, optionally using the previous call's (F, DX) pair to refine DFDX between iterations.

nodes.name: test_fail_fast_tracker.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite covering FailFastTracker in scripts/synthesis_validation: threshold behaviour, success-reset semantics, repeated-error tracking, and summary formatting.

nodes.name: test_grid_generation.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive pytest suite for scripts/generate_grid covering parameter resolution (values, min/max/step, distributions), Latin-hypercube sampling, abundance formatting, CSV/Zarr writers, and ML-sampling output columns.

nodes.name: test_jax_spectra_dataloader.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite for scripts/jax_spectra_dataloader exercising train/val/test split logic, the SpectraZarrDataset wrapper, IO-key inference, and standardization — with the jax import mocked so the suite runs without a JAX install.
nodes.languageNotes: Mocks the jax / jax.numpy modules in sys.modules before importing the production module.

nodes.name: test_lazy_spectrum_loader.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite for scripts/lazy_spectrum_loader covering parameter-assignment parsing, byte/string decoding, LazySpectrumLoader row lookup (exact, partial, missing), spectrum fetching, and rejection of malformed Zarr stores.

nodes.name: test_merge_spectra_shards.py

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand what this repository actually is: a scalable Python wrapper around the legacy Turbospectrum Fortran radiative-transfer code, used to generate large synthetic stellar spectral grids (LTE and NLTE) for ML training. It lays out the end-to-end setup path (build Fortran binaries, download input data, configure one file, run the pipeline) and the core data-flow narrative the rest of this tour follows: config -> parameter grid -> sharded synthesis -> merged store -> ML-ready dataset. Read it first to get the map before exploring the territory.

tour.title: Architectural Contracts
tour.description: Before touching code, internalize the non-negotiable rules that shape every design decision. SYSTEM_RULES.md states the five load-bearing rules (shard idempotency, output immutability, atomic writes, config-as-truth, no nested multiprocessing); ARCHITECTURE.md explains the shard-first design and parallelism model; INVARIANTS.md enumerates the 15 properties that must always hold. These docs exist because the pipeline runs at scale on HPC where violating an invariant means silently corrupting a multi-day run.

tour.title: The One-Config Pipeline Entry Point
tour.description: pipeline_from_config.py is the preferred single entry point and the backbone of the whole system. It resolves output paths, generates the parameter grid (LHS or Cartesian), materializes a temporary Turbospectrum config, runs an NLTE preflight, and dispatches synthesis -- orchestrating the downstream stages you'll meet in later steps rather than importing them directly (it shells out to them as subprocesses, which is why it has few code-level dependencies). This is where the README's data-flow becomes executable code.
tour.languageLesson: This orchestrator invokes the per-stage scripts via subprocess rather than importing them, keeping each stage independently runnable and restartable -- a deliberate consequence of the shard-first contract from Step 2.

tour.title: Config-as-Truth
tour.description: The pipeline treats configuration as the single source of truth: any physics-affecting parameter that can't be traced to a config file is an architectural leak. The canonical template covers Latin-Hypercube sampling across the full FGKM parameter space (teff, logg, feh), the wavelength window, output mode (Flux/Intensity), compression, and runtime knobs (workers, chunk rows). Study it to understand the vocabulary every downstream stage reads from.
tour.languageLesson: JSON configs here use a deep-merge override pattern: a base template is merged with run-specific overrides so that one canonical schema drives both LHS and Cartesian grids without duplicating the full parameter set.

tour.title: Stage 1 - Parameter Grid Generation
tour.description: Building on the config from Step 4, grid generation turns parameter axes into a concrete list of stellar models to synthesize. generate_grid.py is the core library/CLI that performs Latin-hypercube (ML/LHS) or Cartesian sampling and validates against the frozen parameter space, while synthesize_regular_grid.py is the Cartesian sampler it delegates to for regular grids. The output is a grid CSV plus parameter_grid.zarr with an index.parquet -- the frozen, content-addressable input every shard reads from.

tour.title: The Fortran Engine and Its Build
tour.description: The Python wrapper exists to drive a legacy Fortran radiative-transfer code. babsma.f pre-computes the continuous absorption coefficient grid from a model atmosphere; bsyn.f then reads those opacities plus atomic/molecular line lists and solves LTE/NLTE line synthesis to produce a spectrum (bpl.f is the Planck-function helper used throughout). The gfortran Makefile wires all the source files into the babsma_lu and bsyn_lu binaries the pipeline shells out to.
tour.languageLesson: Makefile targets (all, babsma_lu, bsyn_lu, eqwidt_lu) declare build steps with dependency tracking; the two-program babsma->bsyn split mirrors the physics: continuous opacity must be computed before line synthesis can run.

tour.title: The Turbospectrum Subprocess Wrapper
tour.description: run_turbospectrum.py is the most depended-upon module in the codebase (highest fan-in): it normalizes the config, resolves linelist and atmosphere paths, interpolates model atmospheres, sizes worker pools, and actually invokes the babsma_lu/bsyn_lu binaries from Step 6. NLTE handling is centralized in nlte_config.py, which propagates a single calculation_mode switch and runs preflight validation so an NLTE run fails fast rather than producing wrong physics.

tour.title: Stage 2 - Sharded Synthesis
tour.description: This is the heart of the shard-first design from Step 2. run_turbospectrum_shard.py is the shard-level worker: it runs Turbospectrum over an assigned slice of grid rows, batches tasks, and writes an independent, idempotent, restartable output shard. synthesize_spectra_from_zarr.py is the non-sharded counterpart for smaller runs. resolve_shard_layout.py is the shared resolver that ceiling-divides the row count into shards so every PBS array job agrees on the same layout.

tour.title: Provenance, Validation, and Output Parsing
tour.description: These shared libraries enforce scientific correctness around every shard. provenance_contract.py defines the required provenance fields and deterministic hashes (config, grid, binary manifest) so outputs are reproducible and content-addressable; synthesis_validation.py is the fail-fast tracker that classifies per-row statuses and surfaces systematic failures; spectrum_output.py parses raw Turbospectrum .spec files into flux/continuum arrays. They are imported across the synthesis and merge stages, which is why they rank high in fan-in.

tour.title: Stage 3 - Merging Shards and the Data Contract
tour.description: Once shards complete, validate_dataset.py checks the shard directory for zarr structural integrity, wavelength consistency, required provenance, and shard-completeness before anything is merged. merge_spectra_shards.py then consolidates the shards into a single schema-compliant spectra.zarr, computing physics hashes and propagating provenance. DATA_CONTRACT.md and DATA_SCHEMA.md specify the mandatory arrays, provenance fields, and exact Zarr layout the merged store must satisfy.

tour.title: Running It For Real - PBS on Gadi
tour.description: Production synthesis runs on the NCI Gadi HPC cluster via a single unified PBS launcher that auto-detects array mode and selects LHS vs regular grids from the config (not the script name). OPERATIONS.md is the operator runbook (preflight, smoke/pilot/production modes, launch and monitoring), and FAILURE_MODES.md catalogues the HPC failure modes -- metadata-server saturation, scratch exhaustion, nested-parallelism collapse -- that the shard-first contract and thread caps are designed to defend against.
tour.languageLesson: PBS wrappers set OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 and use flat ncpus/mem requests rather than select=... node allocation; scaling comes from running many independent shard jobs in a job array, not from threading inside one shard.

tour.title: ML-Ready Output and Downstream Consumers
tour.description: The final stage turns the merged store into training data. rechunk_worker.py re-tiles spectra into ML-friendly chunks (rows=128, lambda=8192) with zstd compression, merge_rechunked.py concatenates the rechunked shards into one ML-ready zarr (driven on Gadi by merge_rechunked_example.pbs), and jax_spectra_dataloader.py provides standardization, train/val/test splits, and batched loading so an emulator can consume the grid directly. This closes the loop from raw Fortran spectra to a dataset an ML model trains on.
